_doc: The Sticker Book (client only; src/client/stickers.ts): stickers you earn once, kept in this browser. Each has a name, a line, its art (assets/ui/<art>.png) and a rule: on = the sim event, and every other key must match that event's field: a number means at least that much, {"max": n} at most, a string or boolean must be equal. count: how many matching events it takes (counted across sessions). The story's stickers come with its missions (missionDone, data/missions.json reward). Besides the sim's events, the client sends placeVisit {name} when you skate into a landmark or neighbourhood (data/ui.json places), schoolGraduate when you finish Skate School (data/school.json), and graffitiOwned {owned} at the end of a Graffiti game (the most pieces anyone owned). distinct: count only different values of that event field (a+b: different pairs).
